stages.title: Register repository and select authenticated cells
stages.admission: Reject ambiguous repository identity or undeclared source mode. Register explicit unavailable model lanes; require compatible inherited weights only when admitting model-dependent execution or inherited training.

stages.title: Capture complete declared inventory
stages.admission: All nonexcluded entries reconcile within frozen bounds; selections cannot narrow inventory; replay needs fresh applicability.

stages.title: Derive native Codebase IR and dependency graph
stages.admission: Native structural observations retain exact spans/versions; unknown semantics remain explicit.

stages.title: Admit model and vector inputs
stages.admission: Reuse only exact input/profile matches; unavailable model lanes retain a deterministic native path.

stages.title: Autoformalize typed obligations
stages.admission: Models propose; expected obligation and unsupported coverage are accounted for independently.

stages.title: Check and index exact evidence
stages.owner: trusted checker and cell evidence-index owners
stages.admission: Historical cache hits do not skip fresh native checks under the existing profile; preserve conditional/kernel/test authority distinctions.

stages.title: Ground versioned intent against observed code
stages.owner: Intent/codebase grounding and typed federation adapters
stages.admission: Preserve current false facts and separate planned-post subjects; ambiguity/unknowns cannot become true.

stages.title: Compile admitted symbolic plan
stages.admission: No fallback marker substitutes for an actual check; review graphs route to a separate approved observation request.

stages.title: Execute measure verify and refresh
stages.owner: DecisionRuntime isolated worker and trusted live observers
stages.admission: Observe before dispatch and around checks; derive satisfaction from actual post-state evidence.

stages.title: Freeze eligible training and evaluation corpus
stages.owner: native target and private model-corpus owners
stages.admission: Training labels are independently established; missing compatible parent or unknown critical atoms require migration/unavailable.

stages.title: Adapt private repository candidate
stages.owner: cell registry and admitted numerical trainer
stages.admission: Inherited mode forbids absent-parent random bootstrap; update algorithms and their replay/optimizer semantics remain explicit.

stages.title: Evaluate and promote scoped candidate
stages.owner: independent evaluator and owner promotion validator
stages.admission: Absolute task fidelity, coverage, retention and authority gates precede compare-and-swap; no loss-only or proof-closing promotion.

stages.title: Deliver immutable history and recover
stages.owner: per-owner outbox lake/Hub delivery and recovery owners
inputs: durable stage/model/evidence receipts as they become available
stages.admission: Streaming side branch; preserve local completion versus optional delivery; recover artifacts/acknowledgments without rerunning training.
